description: Public GCodeProcessor build-volume validation over parsed in-memory G-code: plate bounds, physical-nozzle restrictions, filament restrictions, custom-path exclusion, and clean recheck state.

mutants.old: m_result.gcode_check_result.reset();// including both single extruder machine printable area check result and multi extruder result
mutants.new: m_result.gcode_check_result.error_code = 0;// including both single extruder machine printable area check result and multi extruder result
mutants.description: Clearing only the error bits retains the first failing recheck's area and height metadata; the clean second check must expose empty maps.
Suppress the public plate-area check; the ordinary extrusion outside the explicit plate must lose bit 2 and its <filament,object> area witness.
Suppress the public plate-height check; the tagged Z_HEIGHT:5 extrusion must lose bit 3 and its height witness under the 4 mm limit.
Use the filament ID as the restriction bit instead of the physical extruder ID; the mapped-filament row must distinguish map[1]=physical bit 0 from map[0]=physical bit 1.
